subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should this iOS preview-tour first-run experience be rebased and adopted on top of current main, or should the branch be narrowed or paused now that overlapping mobile onboarding work has landed?
rationale: The remaining blocker is partly mechanical typography work, but the branch also adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, and security-copy decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample preview pieces maintainers still want and leave setup-code or connection-path work to current-main onboarding.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Use the merged current-main onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview tour is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant owns the freshest current-main overlap for the mobile Gateway setup/onboarding surface.
